---
name: Conduct concern
about: Report a conduct concern that can be discussed publicly.
title: "Code of Conduct report"
---

**This issue will be public.** Do not include private information or sensitive details.

For serious abuse, harassment, or concerns involving the maintainer, use [GitHub's reporting tools](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam). You do not need to open a public issue first. GitHub handles these reports under its own community guidelines.

## Concern

Briefly describe what happened and which part of the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/vontanne/galactic-stays/blob/master/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) is relevant.

## Relevant links

Link existing issues, pull requests, or comments that show the concern.

## Suggested resolution (optional)

Describe what would help resolve the concern.
